title: ネオンの路地
description: 雨上がりの路地に控えめなネオンが反射する、都会的な夜景素材です。
creator: @fuuuuuuma

tone.light: 画面外のネオンと小さな実用灯による混合光
tone.colorTemp: 4300K。深いシアンとマゼンタを抑制して使う
tone.framing: 35mm・目線高・16:9。細い路地の消失点を活かす
tone.texture: 濡れた舗装、タイル、金属扉、薄い蒸気

pieces.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: cinematic B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails
Primary request: a narrow empty urban alley after rain, restrained cyan and magenta light reflecting from unseen sources
Scene/backdrop: ordinary backstreet at night with closed plain doors and no activity
Subject: wet alley perspective, pipes, blank walls, and reflections, no living subject
Style/medium: photorealistic nocturnal street photography, natural imperfections, subtle fine film grain
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, eye-level, 35mm lens, centered medium-wide view with a clear vanishing point
Lighting/mood: off-frame neon mixed with small practical lights, 4300K balance, atmospheric but plausible
Color palette: deep charcoal, restrained cyan, muted magenta, dull steel
Materials/textures: wet paving, ceramic tile, painted metal, thin steam
Constraints: one coherent real photograph; no people, no faces, no hands, no silhouettes, no readable text, no neon letters, no logos, no brands, no watermark
Avoid: cyberpunk city, fantasy props, famous landmarks, excessive neon, illustration, CGI look, oversaturation
